definitions.explanation: Medicine or remedy used to suppress or relieve coughing.

examples.japanese: {咳止|せきど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{咳止|せきど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きて。
examples.english: Go buy some cough medicine at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{咳止|せきど}め⟦シロップ→シロップ：21577_shiroppu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{飲|の}みやすい→飲みやすい：21767_nomiyasui⟧。
examples.english: This cough syrup is easy even for children to take.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{咳|せき}→咳：12007_seki⟧ (cough) and ⟦{止|と}め→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ (stopping), referring to medicine that suppresses coughing. Can refer to cough drops, syrups, or tablets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {咳止|せきど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ — to take cough medicine
- {咳止|せきど}め⟦シロップ→シロップ：21577_shiroppu⟧ — cough syrup
- {咳止|せきど}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ — cough medicine
- {咳止|せきど}めドロップ — cough drops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風邪薬|かぜぐすり}→風邪薬：09712_kazegusuri⟧ — cold medicine (broader; treats multiple cold symptoms, not just cough)
- {鎮咳剤|ちんがいざい} — antitussive (medical/technical term for cough suppressant)
